name: Cetos Sport Cafe
kurzbeschreibung:
**Cetos Sport Café in Matrei/Brenner**

Discover the perfect blend of sporty energy and cozy atmosphere at **Cetos Sport Café** in **Matrei/Brenner**. Whether you're an adventurer looking for a quick bite after a hike or a local seeking a caffeine boost, this café is your go-to spot.

Fuel up with hearty Austrian classics like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh pastries, or a steaming bowl of **Gulasch**. For the active crowd, grab a protein-packed smoothie or a post-workout snack to keep your energy levels high.

After your meal, recharge with a selection of specialty coffees, teas, or a cold drink to enjoy on the terrace with a view of the stunning **Zillertal** Alps. The café’s relaxed vibe makes it an ideal place to unwind or meet up with friends.

Located right in the heart of **Matrei/Brenner**, **Cetos Sport Café** is easily accessible and just a short stroll from the **Zillertal Arena** and other outdoor hotspots. Whether you're training for your next expedition or simply soaking in the alpine scenery, this café is your perfect pit stop in **Tirol**.
